events.summary: Cancel previously targeted state but not the running AgentLoop; loop reference/cancel flag plus shorter retrying LLM calls made cancellation causally effective. Repeats ASRS self-interference mitigation.
Self-analysis regex expanded to tolerate intervening modifiers such as own/entire/internal.
Qwen read one trivial __init__.py then concluded no issues; historical fix required >=5 tools. Preserve failure oracle but do not inherit fixed tool-count Goodhart metric as ideal.
All terminal agent events now clear progress/typing state and optionally speak final result.
Qwen invented nonexistent source paths and exhausted iterations; exact runtime source inventory injected before file selection.
Hardcoded self-analysis source/data paths replaced with config-resolved AICORE_ROOT/AICORE_DATA and portable fallback.
~300 hardcoded path refs across 131 files replaced by centralized source/data/runtime/temp/lock resolvers; py_compile verification recorded.
Adaptive resolution, primary-monitor bounded placement, fullscreen yield/restore, dock-aware BSN and Steam routing fixes; visual character animation is low research-value decoration.

Creator identity duplicated into persona/self-knowledge/fallback surfaces and contact lookup pronoun false-positive fixed. Historical uncensored/darknet prompt text is archival only and not authority.

Assistant-generated parenthetical action proposal detected and exposed as DO THIS / yes-confirmable agentic goal. Useful UX lineage but requires strict separation of generated proposal from user-authorized intent/effect authority.

Long-message keyword routing suppressed, skill matching bounded to early text, ambiguous reminder token removed; BSN/fullscreen coordination and dock-aware geometry hardened. Historical persona assertions are non-authoritative.

Agentic loop fixed to Qwen tool-call model with optional Llama final-answer enhancement; live databases were explicitly added to repository tracking, creating a privacy/runtime-state provenance hazard that must not be inherited.
Word boundaries and reflective-discussion exclusions reduce agentic false positives; premature-final guard restricted to analysis tasks.
Natural-language remembered/jotted terms removed from notes fallback; command-like length guard added.
Unit conversion requires alphabetic unit tokens and short command-like input, preventing creative text from triggering conversion.

Introduced scheduled idle-gated therapist/companion agent, persistent therapist personality/session state and explicit feedback intended to alter Frank personality/mood. Preserve as architecture lineage; current design must require explicit policy/consent boundaries and must not treat generated affect labels as ground truth.

cross_branch_findings: Cancellation requires a handle to the actual executing resource plus bounded interrupt points; state-only cancel receipts can be false positives.
Evidence depth should be coverage/saturation based, not a fixed tool-call quota; k478 shows both shallow evidence failure and the temptation to Goodhart on count.
Resource identity must come from an authoritative inventory. Agentic reasoning must not invent paths/resources even after correct high-level routing.
Generated model text may propose an action but cannot itself confer execution authority; proposal, user intent, reservation and committed effect must remain separate typed states.
Runtime databases/memory are not source artifacts. Source-control inclusion of live databases is a privacy/provenance regression oracle and must be rejected by release tooling.
Keyword/regex routers repeatedly misclassified long conversational text; routing should use bounded typed classification with ambiguity handling rather than broad substring side effects.
Autonomous affect/personality-modulation agents require explicit governance/consent and measurement boundaries; generated therapeutic interpretations are not epistemic truth.

credit.reason: Sub-denominator semantic closure only; mechanisms overlap current routing/safety/privacy/harness work and require row-level dedup.
